title: Geometry-Conditioned Fixed-Scaffold Encoders for Time-Warp Robust Sequence Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2609.36809v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Embedding-based retrieval is attractive for long sequence collections because each item can be encoded once and searched by nearest-neighbor ranking. The difficulty is that the objects being indexed are often observed under a noncanonical clock: cardiac cycles stretch with rate, speech changes with tempo, and sensor traces reach comparable states at different speeds. This paper studies a specific source of instability in patch-based encoders for this regime. If patch boundaries are chosen from signal geometry, then the tokenization can change under the same temporal deformation that the representation is expected to tolerate. We propose GeoPatch, a fixed-scaffold patch encoder that keeps token support independent of geometry and uses slope, curvature, acceleration, affine-residual, and confidence descriptors only as continuous conditioning variables. translated_title: 面向时间扭曲鲁棒序列检索的几何条件化固定骨架编码器
translated_abstract: 基于嵌入的检索对于长序列集合很有吸引力，因为每个条目只需编码一次，即可通过最近邻排序进行搜索。困难在于，被索引的对象往往是在非标准时钟下观测得到的：心脏周期会随心率而拉伸，语音会随语速而变化，传感器轨迹会以不同的速度到达可比较的状态。本文研究了在此情形下基于补丁的编码器中一种特定来源的不稳定性。如果补丁边界是根据信号几何来选取的，那么在表示被期望能够容忍的同一种时间变形下，分词方式本身也会发生改变。我们提出了GeoPatch，一种固定骨架的补丁编码器，它使词元的支撑范围独立于几何结构，并仅将斜率、曲率、加速度、仿射残差和置信度描述符作为连续的条件变量。该设计将边界变化转化为特征调制：几何可以改变嵌入……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出GeoPatch固定骨架补丁编码器，通过使词元划分与信号几何解耦、仅将斜率、曲率、加速度等几何描述符作为连续条件变量，解决了时间变形下补丁边界变化导致的表示不稳定问题，实现了时间扭曲鲁棒的序列检索。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes GeoPatch, a fixed-scaffold patch encoder that decouples token boundaries from signal geometry and uses geometric descriptors only as continuous conditioning variables, achieving time-warp robust sequence retrieval.
